points.description: States that the learning rate controls the speed (step size) of convergence: low rate gives slow (overdamped) convergence; high rate gives faster but oscillating/zigzagging (underdamped) convergence.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only says it controls speed/step size, without describing the low/high effects.

points.description: States the danger: if the learning rate exceeds a critical value, learning becomes unstable (diverges).
points.partial_credit: Half marks if mentions oscillation/zigzagging as a danger but not instability/divergence.
